question: Who among the following classical dancers is NOT related to Odissi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geetanjali Lal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Geetanjali Lal** is a renowned Kathak dancer and not associated with Odissi dance.
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. Its origin is traditionally attributed to the traveling bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• Geetanjali Lal has made significant contributions to the Kathak dance form and is known for her performances and teaching.
 
• Other dancers mentioned in the options, such as Mayadhar Raut, Kiran Segal, and Kumkum Mohanty, are all associated with Odissi, a classical dance form from the state of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance:**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the classical dance forms of India originating from the state of Odisha in eastern India.
 
 
• **Kathak Dance:**
 
 
• Kathak is a North Indian classical dance form that originated from the storytelling tradition.
 
• It is known for its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• The dance form has both Hindu and Mughal influences, and it evolved during the Bhakti movement and later in the courts of the Mughal emperors.
 
 
 
• **Mayadhar Raut:**
 
 
• Mayadhar Raut is a celebrated guru and exponent of the Odissi dance form.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the revival and popularization of Odissi dance.
 
 
 
• **Kiran Segal:**
 
 
• Kiran Segal is a renowned Odissi dancer and has been trained under the guidance of prominent Odissi gurus.
 
• She has performed extensively in India and abroad, promoting the art form.
 
 
 
• **Kumkum Mohanty:**
 
 
• Kumkum Mohanty is a distinguished Odissi dancer and choreographer.
 
• She has been awarded several prestigious honors for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
